Needs changes before merge.

### What looks good

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs:89-104` gives each of the 12 buttons in `NAVS` an original name and a short description.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs:260-264` registers `egui::Sense::hover()` and calls `.on_hover_text(tooltip(kind))` only when `hover` contains the button rect `r`.
- Drag suppression in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs:893-898` and click handling in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewcube.rs:225-242` stay intact because `egui::Sense::hover()` does not block click or drag hits on the viewport image below it.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar_tests.rs:115-194` renders actual painted text in `hover_text` and pins all 12 buttons, outside-pointer misses, and drag suppression (`hover = None`).
- The PR adds no `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!()` outside tests, adds zero per-frame allocations, and keeps `viewport_bar.rs` at 281 lines (below the 400-line limit).
- `docs/decisions/2776-toolbar-tooltips.md` records the decision, rationale, dropped options, and change cost.
- No `.nc`, `.cl`, or UI snapshot PNG files change, and the PR body includes `Changelog:` and `Fixes #2776`.

### Results merged with main

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2783` on PR head `af1f247e6` trial-merged with `upstream/main` (`f41aafff4`), without a GitHub runner.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`): `9/9` steps passed (`8.0 min`).
  - `ui build (--no-run)`: passed (`318s`).
  - `ui suites: lib`: `1261 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored` (note: `launch_file_tests::a_solidcraft_design_is_imported` >60s).
  - `ui suites: boundary`: `3 passed; 0 failed`.
  - `ui suites: boundary_picks`: `7 passed; 0 failed`.
  - `ui suites: sinker_setup`: `2 passed; 0 failed`.
  - `ui suites: tap_hand`: `3 passed; 0 failed`.
  - `ui suites: theme_example`: `3 passed; 0 failed`.
  - `ui suites: theme_files`: `17 passed; 0 failed`.
  - `ui suites: waterjet_tool`: `1 passed; 0 failed`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` (with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`): passed with `0` warnings.
- Extra suites run (no `testdata/` or importer code changed; ran additional UI suites):
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test shell -- --test-threads=6` (cwd `crates/ui`): `21 passed; 0 failed`.
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test egui_app -- --test-threads=1` (cwd `crates/ui`): `8 passed; 0 failed` (failed with `SIGSEGV` when run concurrently at `--test-threads=6`, unrelated to `viewport_bar.rs`).
- Mutations (run locally in the review worktree, then restored cleanly):
  1. Removed `ui.interact(...).on_hover_text(tooltip(kind))` at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs:261-264`: `every_bottom_toolbar_button_explains_its_action_on_hover` failed (`5 passed; 1 failed`). Restored the code: `6 passed; 0 failed`.
  2. Removed the `if hov` guard at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs:261` so `ui.interact(...).on_hover_text(...)` always runs: `bottom_toolbar_does_not_show_tooltips_outside_or_when_hover_is_suppressed` failed on `Frame: hover suppressed during drag` (`5 passed; 1 failed`). Restored the code: `6 passed; 0 failed`.

### Requested before merge

1. **PR body and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs:260-264`: Add before and after screenshots of the viewport toolbar.**
   - This PR changes UI output in `crates/ui`. The PR body has no screenshots and states that an interactive desktop session did not run.
   - Capture a before image and an after image that show the bottom center toolbar with hover help visible on a button.
   - Push the image files only to the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the PR body. Do not commit screenshot files to the PR branch.

### Questions / notes

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs:261-264` (non-blocking): `ui.interact(...)` runs only when `hov` is `true`. Because `egui::MemoryOptions::repaint_on_widget_change` defaults to `false` in `egui` `0.36.2`, `Response::hovered()` is `false` on the first frame the pointer enters a button rect. The native window's `followup_redraw` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window/frame.rs:335` schedules a second frame on pointer move, whereas `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_web.rs` does not. Calling `ui.interact(..., egui::Sense::hover())` for each button and gating only `.on_hover_text(tooltip(kind))` on `if hov` starts the tooltip timer on the first hover frame in both shells.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs:100-102` (non-blocking): The `Orbit`, `Pan`, and `Zoom` tooltips say `"Drag to ..."`, while clicking those buttons latches `state.nav_tool` for subsequent viewport drags. Text like `"Switch drag to ..."` or `"Turn on ... drag mode."` matches the latch action more closely.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
